title.zh: Fake AI crypto software is secretly replacing browser wallet extensions

current_state.zh: HP Wolf Security reported a fake AI crypto-trading assistant that installs Needle Stealer malware, which replaces seven browser wallet extensions on infected Windows machines to steal credentials.
